description: This file defines the tlReports class, which encapsulates functionality for generating test report data within the TestLink project. It includes methods for retrieving report lists, counting builds, and tallying test cases linked to a test plan, and it interacts with a database and configuration files.

classes.name: tlReports
classes.description: A class that handles creation of reports and metrics data for test plans, providing methods to retrieve report lists, count builds, and count test cases associated with a specific test plan.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the tlReports object with a database handler and an optional test plan ID.

methods.name: get_list_reports
methods.description: Returns an array of report entries with links, toggle options, and direct access features based on the provided context and format.

methods.name: get_count_builds
methods.description: Counts the number of builds related to the current test plan, with optional filters for active and open builds.

methods.name: get_count_testcase4testplan
methods.description: Counts the number of test cases linked to the current test plan.
